nodes.label: PyInstaller Sidecar Packaging
nodes.rationale: PyInstaller bundles server.py's uvicorn.run entrypoint plus all Python deps into one platform-specific executable listening on 127.0.0.1:8787 only; Tauri's externalBin convention requires the binary suffixed with the target triple (and .exe on Windows), so CI renames/copies the PyInstaller output after building.

nodes.label: SQLite Motor-Compatibility Shim
nodes.rationale: backend/sqlite_compat.py mimics the narrow subset of Motor's async API this codebase actually calls, storing one SQLite table per collection as id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, doc TEXT (a JSON blob) and filtering/sorting/limiting in Python rather than translating to SQL — deliberately simple since a single-user desktop app's dataset is tiny and the codebase never uses complex Mongo filters.

nodes.label: Tauri Desktop Packaging
nodes.rationale: Packages Web Dojo as a self-contained desktop app: a Tauri 2.x shell wrapping the existing React build, the existing FastAPI backend as a PyInstaller sidecar (no system Python required), and a new SQLite compatibility shim active only in the desktop build so the MongoDB web deployment is unchanged.

nodes.label: Background Music Feature
nodes.rationale: Page-level background music: MP3 renders a floating play/pause pill widget, MIDI loads html-midi-player via CDN; buildMusicHtml's url/accent/label were found unescaped and fixed to use escAttr/escText.

nodes.label: Stripe + PayPal Commerce Integration
nodes.rationale: Stripe (real Payment Links/Checkout Sessions) and PayPal (client-side Smart Buttons SDK) checkout for exported static sites; commerce.js's build-time HTML emitters were found to interpolate free-text fields unescaped, unlike cart.js's own runtime esc() — an inconsistency fixed by the shared escapeHtml utility.

nodes.label: Encrypted Publish Presets
nodes.rationale: Encrypted (Fernet) FTP/FTPS/SFTP profile storage; only ciphertext (password_enc) is ever persisted, API responses expose only has_password. The /secret endpoint deliberately returns plaintext with no per-endpoint auth, consistent with the single-user no-auth trust model, closed against browser-based exfiltration by the CORS fix rather than by adding auth.

nodes.label: Starter Aesthetic Gallery
nodes.rationale: 28 curated single-page starter templates seeded on backend startup with fixed IDs (idempotent upsert), each with a matched aesthetic slug/palette/fonts; not deletable by users (DELETE returns 403).

nodes.label: Web Dojo WYSIWYG Builder
nodes.rationale: A WYSIWYG website builder (React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend, FastAPI + Motor + MongoDB backend) supporting drag-and-drop and code editing, HTML import with section-scanning, a Photoshop-style color/gradient editor, standalone HTML and HTML+CSS zip export; no auth by design (single-user, local-first).

nodes.label: JPY Zero-Decimal Currency Fix
nodes.rationale: Stripe amount builders unconditionally multiplied by 100 to get the smallest currency unit, but JPY is a zero-decimal currency and must be passed as-is — a JPY payment link for ¥500 actually charged ¥50,000. Fixed via a ZERO_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES set consulted by a new _to_unit_amount helper shared by both Stripe amount builders.

nodes.label: New Dashboard / New Dashboard-Blog Wizard Modes
nodes.norm_label: new dashboard / new dashboard-blog wizard modes

nodes.label: classedHtmlPaneSync Module
nodes.rationale: New module used only by the Code view's HTML tab: displays the classed perElement output but resolves edited class references back against the classMap/CSS captured at the moment that text was generated, splicing the original declaration back in as a style attribute so 'this class' keeps pointing at 'this occurrence' during an edit.

nodes.label: CodeView Four-Tab CodePen Redesign
nodes.rationale: Code mode redesigned from a read-only generated-output pane + editable head into four live-synced Monaco tabs (HTML, CSS, JS, Head) plus a debounced live preview iframe; HTML/CSS edits route through one shared debounced update function so a fast edit in one pane can't be clobbered by a stale reconciliation from the other.

nodes.label: CSS Pane Live Two-Way Sync
nodes.rationale: Regex-matches '.el-<id>{...}'/'.el-<id>__n{...}' rule blocks out of the pane text and writes matched declarations back onto the corresponding element's style attribute by occurrence index; an occurrence the pane didn't mention is left untouched rather than blanked.

nodes.label: HTML Pane Live Two-Way Sync
nodes.rationale: DOMParser-parsed top-level nodes are reconciled against the elements array by root id — a matching id updates that element in place, a missing/unrecognized id becomes a new element with a fresh uid(), and an existing element whose id no longer appears is removed; output order follows the parsed nodes' order.

nodes.label: Live Classed Rendering (Derive, Don't Migrate)
nodes.rationale: stripInlineStyles(elements) gains a perElement array so Canvas can render each element's classed fragment via useMemo, with CSS injected into document.head — elements[i].html storage keeps its inline-style shape unchanged, the classed view is always derived, never the source of truth. Inline contentEditable text editing must keep reading/writing raw inline el.html, never the classed projection.

nodes.label: Stable Id-Based CSS Class Naming
nodes.rationale: _strip_inline_styles/stripInlineStyles rewritten to emit a stable id-based class per element (.el-<id>, .el-<id>__1, __2...) replacing the old scan-order counter (el-0, el-1...) which broke when elements were reordered, added, or removed — required so the live CSS-pane editor can round-trip an edit back onto the correct element.

nodes.label: Clean-Export Grid Responsiveness Fix
nodes.rationale: The clean-export path calls _strip_inline_styles/stripInlineStyles before assembling the page, removing the style attribute RESPONSIVE_CSS's grid selector depends on, so grid-collapse silently did nothing there. Fixed by having the extraction functions emit a companion @media override alongside any extracted grid-template-columns rule.

nodes.label: Global Stripe key / no Stripe Connect (limitation)
nodes.norm_label: global stripe key / no stripe connect (limitation)

nodes.label: POST /api/submissions Body-Size Cap
nodes.rationale: /api/submissions is reachable by anonymous internet visitors by design with no Content-Length ceiling, allowing resource exhaustion via an arbitrarily large body fully buffered before validation. Fixed with a 1MB cap enforced by reading the request stream incrementally and aborting early, caching the body so downstream parsing can reuse it.

nodes.label: Fernet Key File Permissions Fix
nodes.rationale: The auto-generated Fernet key file, which decrypts every saved publish-preset password, is written with the process's default umask (typically world/group-readable); os.chmod to 0600 immediately after write restricts it to owner read/write only.

nodes.label: escRawScript / _esc_raw_script Helper
nodes.rationale: Neutralizes a literal '</script' inside raw JS source (custom_js) by backslash-escaping the '/', since HTML's script-content parsing rule ends the block at the first literal '</script' substring found even inside a string/comment/template literal; mirrored identically on backend and frontend to stay in sync.

nodes.label: Shared escapeHtml Utility
nodes.rationale: Three separate, non-shared HTML-escaping implementations (forms.js's escape, exportHtml.js's escAttr, cart.js's inline runtime esc()) meant most free-text-to-HTML interpolation sites never escaped at all, causing stored XSS. Consolidated into frontend/src/lib/escapeHtml.js exporting escAttr (attribute-safe) and escText (text-safe), applied at every previously-unescaped site.

nodes.label: iframe Sandbox allow-same-origin Fix
nodes.rationale: All srcDoc iframes combined allow-scripts with allow-same-origin, giving injected preview content the app's real origin instead of an opaque one, letting any XSS injection reach back into the parent's DOM/localStorage. Fix drops allow-same-origin since none of the four iframes need same-origin access.

nodes.rationale: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers anyway and the frontend never sends credentials, so allow_credentials is set False and the default origin allowlist narrowed to localhost-only, closing browser-based exfiltration of endpoints like the plaintext publish-preset secret.

nodes.rationale: HTML attribute opt-in marking exactly the flex-row wrapper elements that should stack to flex-direction:column on mobile, since most display:flex usage in the block library is small inline UI groups that should stay row at any width; ships as infrastructure only, no block currently needs it.

nodes.label: Remove Hardcoded Stripe Fallback Key
nodes.rationale: stripe.api_key = ... or 'sk_test_emergent' baked a hardcoded placeholder key into the binary and let commerce_config report inconsistent state; commerce endpoints now return 503 when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset instead of silently using the fake key.

nodes.label: setAttr/setInnerText String.replace Pattern Bug
nodes.rationale: setAttr/setInnerText pass user text as the replacement argument to String.prototype.replace(), where sequences like $&, $\`, $', $1 are special replacement-pattern syntax, silently corrupting output. Fix: pass a replacer function instead of the raw string.

nodes.label: Form Submissions Inbox
nodes.rationale: Forms built in Web Dojo POST to /api/submissions so deployed/previewed sites capture real entries; buildFormHtml injects hidden metadata inputs and an inline script that intercepts submit and POSTs FormData via fetch. Later scoped per-project by the round-2 audit fix after being found unscoped.

nodes.label: Publish Filename Path Traversal Fix
nodes.rationale: html_filename/css_filename were free text used verbatim as the FTP/SFTP upload target with no rejection of '/', '\\', or a leading dot, allowing writes outside the configured remote_path. Fixed by rejecting any filename containing a path separator or starting with a dot, returning 400.

nodes.label: SSRF Fix in POST /api/import/url
nodes.rationale: Validate the resolved IP of the URL (and every redirect hop, revalidated manually rather than via httpx follow_redirects) against private/loopback/link-local/reserved ranges before fetching, since unrestricted server-side fetch could reach internal addresses like cloud metadata endpoints.

nodes.label: /api/submissions Unscoped GET/DELETE Fix
nodes.rationale: GET/DELETE /api/submissions matched everything when called with an empty filter, letting any visitor of any exported site enumerate or wipe all form submissions across every project. Fix requires a non-empty project_id or form_name else 400; the Inbox UI is scoped to the current project instead of a global cross-project view — a deliberate, discussed behavior change.

nodes.label: Shared HTML-Assembly Injection Points
nodes.rationale: The four page HTML-assembly functions (backend _project_to_html and _build_project_bundle; frontend buildStandaloneHtml and buildCleanExport) are the shared touch-point set repeatedly extended: custom_js (codepen-editor) and RESPONSIVE_CSS (responsive-export) are both spliced into the same four points.

nodes.label: RESPONSIVE_CSS Injection Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A single shared RESPONSIVE_CSS <style> block (duplicated independently in Python and JS since the two HTML-assembly paths don't share code) injected into every page the app emits: a blanket @media (max-width:768px) rule collapses any inline grid-template-columns to 1fr, safe for virtually all real grid layouts.
